title: Thanksgiving Table: 5 Non-Alcoholic Beers Worth Pouring
excerpt: A bone-dry West Coast pils, a rare small-batch Mexican lager, a balanced ale and two juicy IPAs. Five NA beers for the Thanksgiving table, plus build your own 12-pack.
intro:
Thanksgiving is next week, and the drinks deserve as much thought as the stuffing. A good beer on the table cuts through rich gravy, keeps up with a long afternoon of football and still tastes great with a leftover turkey sandwich on Friday.

Whatever your reason for pouring NA this year, here are five picks built for the holiday table, from crisp and dry to bright and hoppy. Every one is a single can, so mix them into a Build Your Own 12-Pack and set out something for everyone at dinner.

blurbs.40365: Beaglepuss takes a classic pilsner and gives it a West Coast hop twist: lean, bone-dry and crisp, with bursts of citrus and pine and a hint of dank resin over clean pilsner malt. That dry, snappy finish is exactly what you want next to buttery mashed potatoes and salty gravy. Pour it with the main course.
blurbs.40091: Switchback NA Ale is all about balance: a bright hop aroma, subtle fruity notes from the brewery's own house yeast and a smooth malt backbone. It's brewed with the same care as the rest of Switchback's lineup, using the BrewVo system. An easygoing pour that works with everything on the plate, from turkey to the leftover sandwich the next day.
blurbs.40920: Best Day keeps this one simple with just five ingredients: water, barley, hops, yeast and real mango. It's sweet, a little tart and bright with citrus, with a crisp, refreshing finish. Open one while the turkey's in the oven or set it out with the appetizers.
blurbs.40972: Krush is Switchback's full-bodied hazy NA IPA, made in collaboration with Yakima Chief Hops and Sustainable Beverage Technologies. Expect a tropical aroma with layers of orange, citrus and exotic fruit, and a smooth body that stays easy to drink. It's the one to crack when the Thanksgiving football game kicks off.
blurbs.40815: This Mexican-style lager is a rare find: BrewVo and New Terrain brewed it in small batches for the 2026 Great American Beer Festival, aiming for gold. Corn and a touch of Vienna malt keep it crisp and crushable, and a Motueka and Abstrax dry hop adds a bright lift. Small-batch cans don't last, so grab a couple for the table while they're here.

outro: Mix these five into a Build Your Own 12-Pack at nabeermarket.com and stock up for the holiday table, with free shipping to all 50 states. If you'd rather have someone pick for you each month, NA Beer Club has you covered.
